Hey everyone - was wondering if anyone could share their experience on going above the 90 days limit abroad and then going to a visa renewal?
I am still within the limit but I might need to exceed it from 2 weeks. I was thinking because there was a war and I left the country for a month, it might be easier to justify? Or are they super strict and would just cancel my visa?

I have a friend that traveled for more than 6 months and they didn’t even mention it when she renewed her visa - might be just luck?
